reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum, Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.73% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +2bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 143 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 90 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 15.4 sits at the 16th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 13.2, so implied carries +2.3 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nebius upsizes convert to $5B and forces exchange of $800M in existing notes for shares; stock dives 14% before rebounding
items.note: Upsized from $4.5B to $5B and paired with an $800M note-for-equity swap on the 2029/2031 converts — a realized, dilutive refinancing that shows a neocloud leaning on capital markets rather than cash flow to fund GPU buildout.

items.headline: SoftBank readies record ¥1tn retail bond as Nvidia and Oracle CDS spreads widen further
items.note: Nvidia's 5-year CDS hit 80.77bp (+90% YTD, more than doubled since May) and Oracle's stayed above 200bp as SoftBank moves to raise a record retail bond to fund its AI/OpenAI commitments — concrete credit-spread widening tied to AI-infra counterparties.

items.headline: CoreWeave, Nebius, TeraWulf slide as Anthropic's $65B and OpenAI's $40B ARR land below whisper numbers
items.note: CoreWeave -6.8%, Nebius -5.2%, TeraWulf -6.5% on the combination of an AI-revenue miss versus expectations at the two largest model labs and the WSJ's fresh $3T sizing of hyperscaler off-balance-sheet lease/purchase commitments — a revenue-disappointment signal feeding directly into neocloud counterparty risk.

items.headline: Nvidia scales OpenAI/SB Energy financing backstop down to ~$120B from a rumored $250B, still negotiating up to $350B in GPU financing
items.note: SEC 8-K quantifies Nvidia's guaranty exposure on the SB Energy-built, OpenAI-leased Ohio campus; even scaled back, it's a concrete, dollar-sized escalation of the circular-financing/SPV web the credit thesis is watching for collection risk if AI revenue disappoints.

items.headline: Anthropic-tied Nexus Data Centers (Hubbard, TX) closes $1.3B private-credit loan inside a $16B project-finance package
items.note: Single-tenant (Anthropic) concentration risk on a large private-credit-funded campus with its own gas plant — not distress on its own, but adds to the private-credit book of AI-tenant-concentrated debt this thesis tracks.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
